# Voluntarios
```{r}
glimpse(old_data$vols)

# Missing vals
old_data$vols |> 
  summarize(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.x))))

# Check duplicates
old_data$vols |> 
  count(id) |> 
  filter(n > 1)
```
Need to address:

  1. Appropriate column types
    - `edad` is a character
    - `disponibilidad`, `bloques`, `ubicaciones` are list columns
  2. Accents and capitalizations
  3. Empty strings vs NA
    - `proyectoPref` and `comentarios`
  4. Legacy username
    - `volUsuario`

## Frequencies of character columns

```{r}
old_data$vols |>
  summarise(across(c(area, rol, tipo, edad), ~ n_distinct(.x)))

old_data$vols |>
  count(area, rol, tipo, sort = TRUE)

old_data$vols |>
  summarise(across(where(is.character), ~ sum(trimws(.x) == "", na.rm = TRUE)))
```

# Initialize working vols df
```{r}
voluntarios <- old_data$vols |>
  clean_names() |>
  # handles step 3, empty string to NA
  mutate(across(where(is.character),
                ~ na_if(trimws(.x), "")))|>
  relocate(id, vol_usuario)

glimpse(voluntarios)
```
## 1. Fix column types
```{r}
voluntarios <- voluntarios |>
  mutate(edad = as.integer(edad))
```

## 2. Normalize accents and capitalization
```{r}
# 2. Normalize accents and capitalization
voluntarios <- voluntarios |>
  mutate(across(c(area, rol, tipo), ~ stri_trans_general(str_to_lower(.x), "Latin-ASCII")))
```

## 4. Preserve legacy usernames
```{r}
# 4. Preserve legacy usernames
voluntarios <- voluntarios |>
  rename(legacy_usuario = vol_usuario)
```


# Confirmaciones
A few issues here. Duplicate records for volId 45 on weeks 2026-08-03 and 2026-08-17.
There is also a mix of NA values and empty strings that I think are meant to represent an NA value.
For migration, will consider any empty strings to be an NA.
`validado` only has TRUE or NA, will leave NA as NA.
`centros` and `obs` both contain empty strings that should be NA values
```{r}
names(old_data$confirm)

# old_data$confirm |> 
#   unnest(cols = dias)

# Check duplicates
old_data$confirm |> 
  # unnest(cols = dias) |> 
  count(volId, semana, bloque) |> 
  filter(n > 1)

# Check if duplicates are identical
old_data$confirm |> 
  filter(volId == 45,
         semana %in% c("2026-08-03", "2026-08-17")) |> 
  select(id, volId, semana, bloque, dias) |> 
  unnest(dias)
```

```{r}
# double check empty string in dias columns for single week
old_data$confirm |>
  filter(volId == 45, semana == "2026-08-17") |>
  unnest(cols = dias) |>
  select(id, Martes, Jueves, Viernes, Miércoles, Lunes) |>
  mutate(across(-id, ~ case_when(is.na(.x) ~ "MISSING (NA)",
                                 .x == "" ~ "EMPTY STRING",
                                 TRUE ~ .x)))

old_data$confirm <- old_data$confirm |> 
  mutate(volId = as.character(volId))

# look at missingness across all weeks in dias
confirm_missigness <- old_data$confirm |>
  select(id, volId, dias) |> 
  unnest(cols = dias) |>
  pivot_longer(c(-id,-volId), names_to = "dia", values_to = "estado") |> 
  mutate(estado = case_when(is.na(estado) ~ "MISSING (NA)",
                            estado == "" ~ "EMPTY STRING",
                            TRUE ~ estado))

# write_csv(confirm_missigness, "confirm_missingness.csv")
```

This is how dias are handled in the original index.html
The volunteer interface creates a new confirmation obs `dias:{}`

## Cleaning confirmaciones
Need to 

  1. Normalize empty strings to NA
  2. Identify and resolve duplicate weekly records
  3. Validate cleaned confirmations
  4. Transform them into two PostgreSQL tables
  
### 1. Normalize empty strings to NA
```{r}
# Normalize empty strings
confirmaciones_completas <- old_data$confirm |>
  # select(id, volId, dias) |> 
  unnest(cols = dias) |>
  clean_names() |> 
  pivot_longer(c(lunes, martes, miercoles, jueves, viernes), names_to = "dia", values_to = "estado") |>
  mutate(estado = na_if(estado, ""),
         centro = na_if(centro, ""),
         obs = na_if(obs, ""))

# Check duplicates
confirm_dupes <- confirmaciones_completas |> 
  count(vol_id, semana, bloque, dia) |> 
  filter(n > 1)

# Compare full values for each duplicate record
dupe_compare <- confirmaciones_completas |> 
  semi_join(confirm_dupes, by = c("vol_id", "semana", "bloque", "dia")) |> 
  arrange(semana, bloque, dia, id)

# glimpse(dupe_compare)
```

All NA: `centro`, `obs`, `validado`, `estado` for August 17
Identical, can keep one record: `vol_id`, `semana`, `bloque`
Combine: `estado` August 3
ID's can be kept because they will be used in the migration

```{r}
# Merge
confirmaciones_completas <- confirmaciones_completas |> 
  group_by(vol_id, semana, bloque, dia) |> 
  summarize(legacy_ids = list(unique(id)),
            estado = first(estado, na_rm = TRUE),
            centro = first(centro, na_rm = TRUE),
            obs = first(obs, na_rm = TRUE),
            validado = first(validado, na_rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# glimpse(confirmaciones_completas)
```

### 2. Check duplicates
```{r}
# Check weekly duplicates
# Check for conflicting weekly-level values
confirmaciones_completas |>
  group_by(vol_id, semana, bloque) |>
  summarize(n_centros = n_distinct(centro, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_obs = n_distinct(obs, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_validado = n_distinct(validado, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_centros > 1 |
           n_obs > 1 |
           n_validado > 1)
```

```{r}
rm(confirm_missigness, confirm_dupes, dupe_compare)
```

#### Weekly duplicate merge
```{r}
confirmacion_semanal <- confirmaciones_completas |> 
  group_by(vol_id, semana, bloque) |> 
  summarize(legacy_ids = list(unique(unlist(legacy_ids))),
            centro = first(centro, na_rm = TRUE),
            obs = first(obs, na_rm = TRUE),
            validado = first(validado, na_rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

glimpse(confirmacion_semanal)
```

#### Daily duplicate merge
```{r}
confirmacion_dia <- confirmaciones_completas |> 
  filter(!is.na(estado)) |> 
  select(vol_id, semana, bloque, dia, estado)

glimpse(confirmacion_dia)
```

### 3. Validate relationships between the tables
Every record in `confirmacion_dia` should have a parent record in `confirmacion_semanal`.
Should be 0 here
```{r}
confirmacion_dia |>
  anti_join(confirmacion_semanal,
            by = c("vol_id", "semana", "bloque"))
```
### 4. Transform into two tables for postgres
#### Add temp IDs to weekly confirmations
```{r}
confirmacion_semanal <- confirmacion_semanal |> 
  mutate(id = row_number(), .before = 1)
```

#### Add confirmation id's to daily confirmations
```{r}
confirmacion_dia <- confirmacion_dia |> 
  left_join(confirmacion_semanal |> 
              select(id, vol_id, semana, bloque),
            by = c("vol_id", "semana", "bloque")) |> 
  rename(confirmacion_id = id) |> 
  select(confirmacion_id, dia, estado)

glimpse(confirmacion_dia)
```

## Validate migrations
```{r}
# Validate confirmation relationships
confirmacion_dia |>
  summarise(n_registros = n(),
            ids_faltantes = sum(is.na(confirmacion_id)),
            ids_invalidos = sum(!confirmacion_id %in% confirmacion_semanal$id),
            dias_duplicados = n() - n_distinct(confirmacion_id, dia),
            estados_faltantes = sum(is.na(estado)))
```

## Confirmaciones y centros
Checking how the center names appear in this part of the legacy data to inform how it'll map to postgres.

### Centros lookup table
```{r}
# Legacy centers in weekly confirmations
confirmacion_semanal |> 
  count(centro, sort = TRUE)

# Center lookup table
centros_lookup <- old_data$centros |>
  clean_names() |>
  select(centro_id = id,
         centro = nombre)

centros_lookup

# Map legacy center ID's to weekly confirmations
confirmacion_semanal <- confirmacion_semanal |>
  left_join(centros_lookup, 
            by = "centro",
            relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  relocate(centro_id, .after = centro)
```
### Centros y confirmaciones mapping validation
```{r}
glimpse(confirmacion_semanal)

# Count unmatched center names
unmatched_centros <- confirmacion_semanal |>
  filter(!is.na(centro) & is.na(centro_id))

nrow(unmatched_centros)

unmatched_centros |>
  select(-legacy_ids)

# Check center mapping
confirmacion_semanal |>
  count(centro, centro_id, sort = TRUE)
```
## Confirm data types
Also clarifying week start
```{r}
# Convert weekly confirmation fields to SQL-compatible types
confirmacion_semanal <- confirmacion_semanal |>
  mutate(vol_id = as.integer(vol_id),
         semana = as.Date(semana)) |>
  rename(semana_inicio = semana)
```

### Type validation
```{r}
glimpse(confirmacion_semanal)

sum(is.na(confirmacion_semanal$vol_id))
sum(is.na(confirmacion_semanal$semana_inicio))
```
